gloss: to repeat a grade; to overlap; to duplicate

definitions.gloss: to repeat a grade; to be held back
definitions.explanation: To fail to advance to the next school year and have to repeat the same grade.

definitions.gloss: to overlap; to duplicate; to double up
definitions.explanation: For things to be duplicated or for schedules to conflict.

examples.english: I had to repeat a year in college.

examples.japanese: このまま{行|い}くとダブるかも。
examples.english: At this rate, I might have to repeat the year.

examples.japanese: ダブらないように{頑張|がんば}る。
examples.english: I'll work hard so I don't have to repeat.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}がダブっている。
{同|おな}じ{本|ほん}がダブって{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bought the same book twice.

notes:
ダブる comes from the English word "double." It's a casual verb formed by adding る to the loanword.

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language. For sense 1, formal alternatives include {留年|りゅうねん}する. For sense 2, use {重複|ちょうふく}する or {重|かさ}なる.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ダブる: to repeat/overlap
- ダブり: duplication (noun form)
- {予定|よてい}がダブる: schedules conflict
